title: Quick standup
setting: A short morning standup on a video call. Maya is leading; Chris is reporting.
situationZh: 早上的短站会，视频通话。Maya 主持，Chris 汇报进度。

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Okay, Chris, you wanna go first?
lines.spoken: Okay, Chris, you wanna go first?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Sure. I'm mostly through the review notes. I should be done today.
lines.spoken: Sure. I'm mostly through the review notes. I should be done today.
lines.meaningZh: 好。评审意见我差不多看完了。今天应该能做完。

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: Not really. I might need a second pair of eyes on the copy, though.
lines.spoken: Not really. I might need a second pair of eyes on the copy, though.
lines.meaningZh: 倒没有。不过文案那块我想再找人看一眼。

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: I can take a look after this.
lines.spoken: I can take a look after this.

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: That'd be great. I'll Slack it over.
lines.spoken: That'd be great. I'll Slack it over.
lines.meaningZh: 那太好了。我一会儿发到 Slack 上。

lines.speaker: maya
lines.text: Sounds good. Are we still okay for Thursday?
lines.spoken: Sounds good. Are we still okay for Thursday?

lines.speaker: chris
lines.text: I think so. If it slips, I'll flag it.
lines.spoken: I think so. If it slips, I'll flag it.
lines.meaningZh: 应该可以。如果要延，我会说一声。

gist.askEn: What kind of help does he want?

details.askZh: 如果周四来不及，Chris 会怎么做？
details.askEn: What will Chris do if Thursday slips?

glue.span: a second pair of eyes on the copy
glue.hear: a second pair of eyes on the copy
glue.noteZh: pair of eyes 是习惯说法，of 很弱；on the copy 会连成一串，copy 在这里指文案，不是「复制」。
glue.standard: a second pair of eyes on the copy

glue.span: If it slips, I'll flag it
glue.hear: If it slips, I'll flag it
glue.noteZh: I'll flag it 里 I'll 被压缩得很短，flag it 的 t 几乎听不见，整体像 I'll flag ih。
glue.standard: If it slips, I will flag it

chunks.sayAfter: Anything blocking you, or are you good?

chunks.form: I can take a look after this.
chunks.meaningZh: 开完这个我可以看一下。
chunks.sayAfter: I can take a look after this, no problem.

chunks.form: If it slips, I'll flag it.
chunks.sayAfter: If it slips, I'll flag it.

roleplay.setupZh: 你在晨会上汇报。你差不多要做完了，只想请人看一眼文案，并保证如果周四来不及会提前说。
roleplay.aiRole: Maya, a calm lead running standup. She asks short questions and offers to help if you need it.
variants: Maya is short on time and wants a 20-second update.
The Thursday date has already moved.
Chris is actually blocked on access.
starters: Not really, but I might need a second pair of eyes.
I think so. If it slips, I'll flag it.

fluency.promptZh: 用自己的话讲刚才这场短会上你汇报了什么、谁答应帮忙。准备 15 秒，然后说 60 秒，再更短、更快地说两遍。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the story of the standup: what you reported, and who offered to help. Prep 15 seconds, then speak for 60, then 45, then 30.
